item.title: New ProTek RC 8000mah 1S Battery and Fan Options
item.description: ProTek RC is proud to announce the release of its new stock spec 1S 150C 8000mAh LiPo shorty battery pack created for 1/12 pan car racing. ProTek RC also is unveiling two new high-speed cooling fans to its product lineup.

item.title: New Upgrade RC 1.9" Crawler Tire Options
item.description: UpGrade RC is announcing a trio of new 1.9” high performance tires for the most popular RC crawling platforms.

item.title: Kyosho MP11e Ebuggy First Look
item.description: Check out the first photos and video of the Kyosho MP11e 1/8th scale electric platform.

item.title: New Hobbywing Team Edition G4R Spec Motors
item.description: Hobbywing would like to introduce the new G4R Team Edition Spec Motors.

item.title: New RawSpeed V2 4wd Front Slick
item.description: Rawspeed RC is happy to announce a new product to the 10th scale slicks in the for of the new 4wd front slick V2. This new and improved V2 slick has a stiff sidewall on a singular side allowing you to choose stiff or soft sidewall options.

item.title: Explaining Hobbywing ESC Neutral Range Settings With Rivkin [VIDEO]
item.description: Spencer Rivkin explains the Neutral Range setting in Hobbywing speed controls, highlighting what it does and how to use it.

item.title: 2026 TNR Fuels Challenge Podiums
item.description: Check out all of the podiums from the TNR Fuels Challenge held this past weekend in Norco, California with an astounding 750+ entries.

item.title: New VP-Pro Poison Needle 1/8th Buggy Tread Pattern
item.description: Following release the Hyperdrive Evo, VP-Pro is thrilled to introduce another new tire for 1/8 scale Buggy, the VP-818 Poison Needle Evo.

item.title: New Donathen RC Heated Battery Sleeve V4
item.description: Donathen RC has released the 4th version of their heated battery sleeve which includes a temperature probe and 3 new optimized temperature options.

item.title: 2026 Southern Indoor Championships Podiums
item.description: Check out the podiums from the 2026 Racetime Entertainment Southern Indoor Championships held this past weekend in Gainesville, Georgia.
